ms.report:
This is the Proof of Achievement document for Milestone 2 of POAP in Cardano Project: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zsZmpTrCQGlIohi_EEZ3Ox2li3H2_pyEyT4KYr9U6xg/edit?usp=sharing
There you can find:
・Link to Open Source GitHub repo with Backend code using Paima Engine
・Link to Open Source GitHub repo with Indexer code also using Paima Engine
・YouTube Link to "Showcase Video: How the POAP Indexer Works"

Acceptance Criteria
Indexer seamlessly shows the state of each POAP a user holds: this is showcased in the video. I will explain how it works:
・The event organizer (issuerId = 0) creates an event (ID 1) against the POAP Smart Contract
・The event organizer (issuerId = 0) creates another event (ID 2) against the POAP Smart Contract
・These 2 events are captured by Paima Engine (from the blockchain) and saved to the local database
・The user claims the POAP for event ID 1
・These new event is captured by Paima Engine and the status for this POAP is recognised as MINT (because the user is minting a POAP from issuerId 0 for the first time)
・Now the user claims the second POAP, but this time for event ID 2
・These event is captured by Paima Engine but this time the status for the POAP is recognised as UPDATE (because the user is minting another POAP from issuerId 0)
・With this we are demonstrating that the Paima Engine and the Smart Contract are working as expected because they recognise the difference between MINTING a new POAP and UPDATING an existing POAP.

Both the Indexer and the Smart Contracts are deployed in Milkomeda Cardano Sidechain (Testnet at this stage), to offer interoperability with Cardano as stated in the project original proposal.

Technical Note
We have been experimenting issues with Milkomeda Testnet RPC. This is why you will find that we are using Polygon Amoy Testnet for this Milestone. We want to express that this is not going to affect the goal of interoperability with Cardano, which is also an essential part of the scope of this project. We just have decided, in order not to delay the development and testing of our protocol, to switch to Polygon Amoy until problems with Milkomeda connectivity are solved.
Problem Creating an Event
Please choose a "Expiry Date" (3 days in the future at least) when creating an event, as the smart contract is enforcing that validation. Once you create the Event, it will appear under the "Events" list and you will be able to "Mint a Token" by clicking the "+" button. Then the minted token will appear under the "Poap Collection" menu.
Please see new Demo Video for reference: https://youtu.be/bXkKc8SbYa8

Note for the reviewers: please check all the documentation provided as the feedback we have received from one of the reviewers is not accurate. The reviewer states that: “The document we have submitted contains only links to UI/UX Designs, the web portal, and 2 very short videos”. This is not what we have submitted for Milestone 4 but for Milestone 3, so clearly one of the reviewers have checked the wrong Milestone documentation. We have submitted all the required documentation in the previous proof of achievement already. In addition to this, the video we submitted is not part of the outputs agreed upon for this milestone, it was just an extra output we decided to include to show the potential of the app, so milestone can’t be refused because the video has “no voice”.
This is the Proof of Achievement document for Milestone 4 of POAP in Cardano Project: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AlKeOy5SI1XCOgcEdGHN1sNDpDArfwCKp-zlESTjqLY/edit?usp=sharing
